entities.summary: Alexei Ivanovich Abrikosov was a Russian entrepreneur and manufacturer who founded the Abrikosov & Sons Factory and Trade Association. He was also the owner of confectionery and tea shops in Moscow, a supplier to the imperial court, chairman of the board of the Accounts Bank. He held of the position of Active State Councillor.
